title: Visuality

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Carry recognizable ingredients into social posts so people can connect varied content to the city at a glance.
strategic_value: Helsinki Grotesk, the logo and wave-divided profiles can link individual social messages to a common civic identity.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture places three social-visuality instructions above a group of phone mockups showing varied city posts.
practical_value: Choose a logo or wave-divided profile image and use the shared visual ingredients while checking equality, consent and accessibility.

content_islands.name: Social guidance
content_islands.spec: Keep profile-image choice, content responsibilities and type recognition together.

content_islands.name: Phone examples
content_islands.spec: Show the overlapping phones as a comparison of different posts within the identity.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text says Helsinki Grotesk supports messages and increases recognition.
reference_purposes.Application: The section specifies logo or wave-divided profile images and shows social-post examples.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Social content must comply with the visual identity and consider equality, consents and accessibility.
